reference.source: matched original editable CapCut draft and supplied rendered video

canvas.default: Preserve the reference aspect and framing unless the current job selects another delivery format. Do not silently crop it to 9:16.
canvas.alternative9x16: When 1080x1920 is explicitly selected, reframe current footage and recalibrate text/panel positions against the active image area; do not stretch the image or copy normalized full-canvas y blindly.

firstStage: current clinic LP/official homepage or user-confirmed facts
afterScriptConfirmation: current presenter call-to-action video with original voice
input.alreadyAuthorizedEdit: If inputs and an approved script/edit instruction are already present, continue editing without restarting approval. Missing clinic facts do not block source analysis.

flow: Read this specification, a08.md and a08-script-reference.json. Keep the two visual/semantic sections separate.

Prepare first-section screen text from current verified facts, preserving the reference order and concise wording. Show the changed facts. For the closing, use actual provided speech; when not recorded yet, label it as a filming script proposal, not a transcript.
After script confirmation, receive treatment/examination footage and the presenter original-voice clip in the same task. Do not require AI voice.

Match the first six shot roles, keeping meaningful therapist/treatment action visible. The last section shows the actual presenter and retains their voice. Durations follow current material and speech.
Create separate editable video, panel, text and sound layers. Apply reference font files and rich text span styles, not one global style. No invented animation or transitions.

Use speech-cleanup.md only for unnecessary fillers/restarts/long pauses in the spoken closing, retaining meaning and word endings. Recalculate subtitle timings after any cut. Do not silence or shorten demonstrations merely for lack of speech.
Apply face-mosaic.md to identifiable real patients and verify movement/reflections/cuts. Do not mosaic the presenter just because patients need privacy.
Compare every caption and cut against the reference, review original voice and optional permitted sound, and check final frame/audio alignment. Use local MP4 delivery when requested.

copyPolicy.closingAsrMismatch: Reference screen ends with ご連絡ください; ASR reported ご覧ください. Do not resolve this as a verified verbatim transcript without checking current original audio.

typography.fontIdentity: Both exact original font files identified; unmodified OFL copies bundled.
typography.sourceUnits: CapCut font_size, shadow distance, border width and transform are source units, not CSS pixels. Use rendered measurements and original phrases to calibrate the current renderer.
typography.richTextPriority: Some material-wide has_shadow=false and shadow_distance=144 conflict with richTextStyles (black shadow alpha0.65/distance8). Preserve both as source observations; compare the visible result, use actual per-span styling, and never treat144 as output px.
typography.promo: White heavy Mincho, usually 2 lines; short tactile-inspection caption is 1 line. Large centered text on a full-width translucent glass-like gray panel.
typography.closing: White rounded bold sans in the lower image, 1–2 lines, no gray panel. Only the relevant emphasis span is red #EC1D1D with white stroke; other spans remain white with black shadow.
typography.lineBreaks: Keep the reference role-specific line count and rhythm, adapt to the approved current wording, never stretch glyphs or cut off a long clinic name.
typography.editable: Text content, cue timing, style and background shape must remain separately editable; wording corrections do not cut original audio.

newProductionLineBreaks.counting: Count displayed grapheme characters, including punctuation, Latin letters and digits; line breaks are excluded.
newProductionLineBreaks.scope: All A08 promo and closing captions in new production; original reference observations remain unchanged.
newProductionLineBreaks.wrapping: Insert explicit breaks at meaningful phrase boundaries before exceeding 8 characters. Preserve names and approved meaning.
newProductionLineBreaks.overflow: If the approved phrase cannot fit meaningfully within 8 characters x 2 lines, split it into subsequent caption cues at semantic boundaries, preserving meaning and readable time for each cue. Never add a third line or reduce font size, horizontal scale or line spacing to squeeze it in.
newProductionLineBreaks.priority: Current user instructions override; otherwise these new-production line length, two-line maximum and spacing rules take priority over archival reference layout.
newProductionLineBreaks.lineSpacing: Use productionDefaults: lineHeight 1.20 with the approved role-specific font sizes; preserve visible separation between glyphs and shadows. Do not compress line spacing to fit text. Verify the actual composite at delivery resolution.

motion.rule: Source motion comes from the footage. Use hard cuts and instantaneous caption changes. Do not add typewriter, zoom, pop, fade or camera animation merely because other patterns use them.

referenceTracks.referenceName: テロップなどが出る時の効果音

audio.observed: Separate mixed soundtrack plus two short effects; original video clip audio is muted in the source draft because audio is on a different track.
audio.newProduction: Preserve current presenter original voice, or use the explicitly approved separated soundtrack. Mute a duplicate camera track only when the selected audio already contains the same voice. Do not import the old presenter voice.
audio.musicAndEffects: Select and add a free instrumental BGM suited to a clinic (calm, clean and welcoming). Verify official distribution terms for commercial SNS video embedding and editing, retain required credits, and record title, creator, source URL and terms. Mix under current speech and use a natural ending fade. Use only permitted SFX; never silently buy or generate audio. Do not redistribute standalone music in the library. Honor an explicit no-BGM instruction.
audio.gain: Reference gains and measured peaks are observations only. Balance new sounds against the current voice and avoid clipping.

referenceArtifacts.tail: Original picture stops at f815, text ends at f816, export has f817 frames. Visual check found f815 text on black and f816 black. Preserve the original in the library preview, but do not recreate accidental black tail in a new edit. Align final picture/text/audio naturally.
referenceArtifacts.captionPictureBoundaryOffsets: Some caption changes precede/follow picture cuts by 1–3 frames. Keep separate layers; reference offsets are not forced onto different speech.
referenceArtifacts.captionGaps: Closing contains intentional/reference gaps between captions; derive current gaps from actual speech rather than stretching captions to fill the whole clip.

verification.scope: Historical reference-registration snapshot from version 0.10.0. See productionDefaults.verificationScope for the approved current production baseline.

validationChecklist: All planned captions visibly present; check every cue at output resolution, not just source parameters.

Every current-production caption uses at most 2 lines and at most 8 displayed characters per line, including punctuation and Latin letters/digits. Split overflow into subsequent semantic cues with readable timing; never use 3 lines or squeeze font size, width or line spacing. Inspect actual line gaps and glyph/shadow separation; reference text is archival only.

Use productionDefaults approved role sizes (125px/107px on 1080x2336), lineHeight 1.20 and zero letter spacing, uniformly scaled for matching aspect ratio. Confirm semantic cue boundaries without fixing count or duration.
Check Mincho vs rounded bold distinction, fill/partial red emphasis, thickness, line breaks, panel, shadow and exact placement.
Check cut boundaries and caption boundaries separately; no stale text, flicker, blank picture or accidental extra animation.
Use actual therapist/examination/treatment scenes; no empty walls/floors as filler.
Check patient-face coverage after all reframing and across reflections/cuts.
Verify words and sync against current original voice; LP facts and old reference wording are separate.
Verify the selected free BGM license, credit requirements, voice balance and ending fade; honor explicit no-BGM instructions and do not reuse another practitioner voice.
Verify export duration, picture/text/audio end alignment and final frame, plus full decode.
Report what is measured, what is inferred and what has actually been rendered.

uncertainties: Raster white-ink boxes exclude most antialiasing and shadow; OCR boxes are separately recorded and can be looser.
The red emphasis cue includes white outline in white-ink bbox; the whole text fill is mixed.
Panel visible raster bound is measured against source baseline. Unclipped full box and radius are estimates from its known 800x357 source aspect and contour.
Shadow sourceStyle distance144.001166 (front) / 8.0 (back) contradicts equal richText distance8.00006485. Preserve both; do not map144 directly to CSS pixels.

fontCompatibility.useWhen: The original Corporate OTF cannot be parsed by the target renderer. Use the original font when it loads correctly; the fallback runtime name is not mandatory.

textLayout.rule: Separate conditions, explanatory phrases and invitations into readable semantic units. Keep each cue within 8 displayed characters per line and 2 lines; use subsequent cues rather than smaller type or a third line.

scaling.sameAspectRatio: Scale pixel values and positions uniformly by output width / 1080 (equal to output height / 2336). Keep unitless lineHeight at 1.20 and letterSpacing at zero.
scaling.differentAspectRatio: Recalibrate positions and safe margins for therapist, treatment and text. Do not stretch or shrink type to fit the number of characters.

timing.rule: Derive cue count, duration and reading time from current speech and approved text; the accepted example is not a fixed template length.

productionDefaults.referencePreservation: This approved production baseline is separate from archival reference text, source CapCut units and raster measurements. Do not rewrite the original reference observations.
productionDefaults.fontNaming: sourceFaceName is the complete face label, not the runtime family. Use preferred family names (OpenType name16) with the explicit weight; confirm registration in the current renderer. The approved rebuilt closing font has its own family A08 Corp Round Full and is optional when the original cannot load.
